entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, I want to return this VeloBand GPS Tracker. I've had it for a couple of weeks and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into a return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Issue? The issue is I've completely changed my mind. It was a total impulse buy, I don't use it, and I don't want it anymore. This shouldn't be complicated. Are you going to process my refund or do I need to speak to your manager?

I understand completely, sir. There's no need for a manager, I can definitely handle this for you. Let me just pull up your purchase details... Okay, I see you received the VeloBand about 20 days ago.
And? Don't tell me I'm past some ridiculous 10-day window. I will light up your company on every social media platform if you try and pull something.
Not at all, sir. I'm just confirming the date. According to our policy here, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can approve this return for a full refund right now. No problem at all.
Oh. Really? So you're just... approving it? A full refund back to my card?

Yes, absolutely. As a VIP member, we want to make sure you're taken care of. Once we receive the item, the full amount will be credited back to your original payment method. I'm generating a prepaid return shipping label and I'll email it to you right now.
Huh. Okay. Well... that's better than I expected. Fine. Send the label.
It's on its way to your inbox. And for the initial frustration, I've also added a $50 VeloFit store credit to your account. We do value your business and hope you'll consider us again in the future.
Fifty dollars? Alright, David. That's good service. I appreciate that. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Just make sure that email comes through.
It should be there already. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
